Unknown, I started from a freshly unpacked karaf-4.0.1... same stacktrace in the console.
Here are my steps:

karaf> feature:repo-add mvn:org.fcrepo/fcrepo-karaf/LATEST/xml/features
karaf> feature:install fcrepo-http-api

On a brand new Ubuntu machine (I mean that), I did the following and could not replicate:

Install java8, maven, git:

sudo apt-add-repository ppa:webupd8team/java
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install oracle-java8-installer
sudo apt-get install maven
sudo apt-get install git
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-8-oracle

Build PR:

git clone https://github.com/acoburn/fcrepo-karaf
cd fcrepo-karaf
git checkout fcrepo-1697
mvn clean install

Install and run Karaf 4.0.1

wget http://mirror.olnevhost.net/pub/apache/karaf/4.0.1/apache-karaf-4.0.1.tar.gz
tar xzvf apache-karaf-4.0.1.tar.gz
cd apache-karaf-4.0.1
./bin/karaf

In the Karaf console:

$> feature:repo-add mvn:org.fcrepo/fcrepo-karaf/LATEST/xml/features
$> feature:install fcrepo-http-api

No errors. Everything installed cleanly.

OS: Ubuntu 14.04.3
JDK: java-8-oracle
karaf: 4.0.1
fcrepo-karaf: 4.3.1-SNAPSHOT

changed property spring.version in pom.xml to 4.1.7.RELEASE_1 and jta.feature.version to 1.3.0, after that I have no problem to

$> feature:repo-add mvn:org.fcrepo/fcrepo-karaf/LATEST/xml/features
$> feature:install fcrepo-http-api
In order to move forward with OSGi work, the PR associated with this ticket needs to be merged.

In the meantime, two new branches are available in fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-karaf: fcrepo-4.4.0 (for use with the current release) and fcrepo-4.4.1 (for use with the current development snapshot). The first should be tagged as a release; the second should be merged with master.

These two branches have also now been successfully tested with karaf 4.0.2

Before running these artifacts in karaf, FCREPO-1581 Closed (update modeshape/infinispan versions) will need to be merged with the main fcrepo4 codebase: infinispan v.6 does not work in OSGi. FCREPO-1776 Closed will also need to be resolved.
Unknown, to be clear, we should not merge this ticket until https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1581 has been closed?

Andrew Woods No, fcrepo-1581 is not blocking this particular ticket. fcrepo-1581 relates to this ticket in that, until it is merged, we can't run modeshape in an OSGi container. However, this ticket relates to simply deploying the fcrepo artifacts in karaf.

Resolved with: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-karaf/commit/a5d2284a18fe9fd7fb9c9e3d0e1f8ff66bd10a07

Note, with a fresh install of karaf-4.0.2, I am still getting a nasty stacktrace in the karaf console when executing the following steps:

karaf> feature:repo-add mvn:org.fcrepo/fcrepo-karaf/LATEST/xml/features
karaf> feature:list | grep fcrepo
karaf> feature:install fcrepo-http-api

However, since additionally this branch is out of date with the rest of the codebase (i.e. there do not exist any 4.3.1-SNAPSHOT bundles), I will move this ticket forward so you can continue with your work.

Do you need to create additional tickets for the various other branches you mentioned in the comments above?
